forensic_case_study.prompt_text: Build a professional expense tracker web app with a dashboard, add/edit/delete transactions, category filters, monthly spending summary, charts, responsive UI, local data persistence, and proper validation. Build it completely and verify everything works.

observed_symptoms.loop_pattern: write_files_batch -> read_file -> write_file -> read_file -> repeated evaluation

verified_baseline_defects.description: QualityVerifier.verify() filters target keywords with 'if len(kw) > 4'. As a result, critical UI domain keywords of 4 characters or fewer (such as 'card', 'form', 'grid', 'nav', 'tab', 'btn') are discarded.
verified_baseline_defects.evidence: In the Expense Tracker mission, task requirement 'Card components implemented' resulted in keyword set [] after filter. Even though HTML contained <article class='card card-balance'> and .card CSS, the verifier returned False and verdict NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT.
verified_baseline_defects.reproduction: Simulated in scratch/reproduce_quality_verifier.py. Returned False against exact prompt 1 HTML.

verified_baseline_defects.description: Background event loop consumer crashes with UnboundLocalError due to missing top-level import of Path when handling structured_feedback events.
verified_baseline_defects.evidence: Causes the Textual UI to permanently freeze at stage [1/7] while backend continues executing or stalls.

verified_baseline_defects.description: ui/app.py:_consume_mission_events drops tool identity during pipeline stage forwarding, leaving user with 'Tool: None'.
NVIDIA NIM remote cloud endpoint (integrate.api.nvidia.com) experiences connection drops, reset by peer, and timeouts under prolonged repeated evaluation retries.

No strict path normalization prevents the agent from creating files in the workspace root vs. generated_projects/ subdirectories. Different components read and write to divergent paths during iteration.
Two disjoint event systems exist in parallel: core/event_bus.py (HermesEvent) and core/mission_runner.py (_event_queue / MissionEvent). TUI consumes only the latter, leading to fragmented telemetry.
